The Department of Transportation issued a notice to explain to Undersecretary for Special Concerns Ricky Alfonso while the Land Transportation Office issued a show cause order against the driver of the official's sports utility vehicle with protocol plate no. 10 and blinkers after they got involved in a traffic altercation in Quezon City on Oct. 8, 2025.

The driver must appear before the LTO on Oct. 17 to explain the circumstances surrounding the incident. His driver's license is suspended for 90 days and he has been fired from his job.

Alfonso may use the "10" plate but his vehicle did not have a registration for it. | via Lloyd Caliwan; 📸 LTO

The group cites the Department of Transportation-Special Action and Intelligence Committee for Transportation’s unfair ticketing practices, as the transport group’s vehicles, largely in good shape and in roadworthy conditions, remain heavily fined.
